What it solves: Scoped after reading the live code rather than the report alone. Verified that `swarmforge.sh` gates its marker read on `ROTATION_MODE == router` and that `babysitter_check.bb:1113` does not. What is NOT claimed: that the babysitter read is the only staffing path, or that it is the specific one tha…
